SCENE sc_001 0-96090 INT. CATHEDRAL – CONTINUOUS
EP41:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: Wide symmetrical shot looking down the candlelit, flower-strewn aisle toward the altar where Rupert, Catherine, and the Priest stand.
EP41:E2 1800-4500 ACTION: Catherine abruptly pulls away from Rupert and raises her white-gloved hand high, commanding silence from the congregation.
EP41:E3 1800-2800 CATHERINE [Imperious, Commanding]: "Wait."
EP41:E4 4500-8500 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking Catherine as she pivots toward the seated aristocracy, her veil floating gracefully behind her.
EP41:E5 4900-8200 CATHERINE [Haughty, Loud]: "Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh..."
EP41:E6 8500-13000 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face, her lips curling into a sadistic, triumphant sneer.
EP41:E7 8500-12700 CATHERINE [Cruel, Resonant]: "...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family."
EP41:E8 13000-15500 CAMERA: Two-shot profile of Rupert and Catherine. Rupert turns to her with mild caution.
EP41:E9 13200-14000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Subdued, Inquiring]: "Catherine..."
EP41:E10 14000-15300 CATHERINE [Callous, Projecting]: "Bring her in."
EP41:E11 15500-17500 SOUND: Heavy wooden creak of the cathedral double doors swinging open.
EP41:E12 15500-20000 CAMERA: Wide shot from behind the altar down the aisle as the great church doors slowly open, revealing the silhouette of three figures against the daylight.
EP41:E13 17500-20000 ACTION: Juliana, dressed in a coarse drab prison dress with a numbered identification badge, is marched forward by two armed constables holding her by the arms.
EP41:E14 20000-22800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana's scarred, dirtied wrists bound tight in heavy iron shackles.
EP41:E15 22800-26000 CAMERA: Intense close-up of Juliana's bruised, dirt-streaked face. Her piercing blue eyes burn with fierce dignity despite her captive state.
EP41:E16 26000-28800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine standing beside the altar, watching Juliana's entrance with gloating satisfaction.
EP41:E17 26800-28400 CATHERINE [Smug, Taunting]: "There she is."
EP41:E18 28800-30000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot of Juliana marching between the stern constables down the central aisle toward the altar.
EP41:E19 30000-34000 CAMERA: Medium shot of a seated aristocratic couple in the pews, whispering and sneering behind an ivory lace fan.
EP41:E20 30500-31600 NOBLEWOMAN [Gleeful, Whispering]: "Look at her."
EP41:E21 31700-33800 NOBLEMAN [Mocking, Chuckling]: "She actually came back to the chapel."
EP41:E22 34000-36800 CAMERA: Close-up of the noblewoman giggling with hand over mouth, glancing spitefully at the disgraced bride.
EP41:E23 34800-36800 NOBLEWOMAN [Scornful, Smug]: "Not as a bride this time."
EP41:E24 36800-39800 CAMERA: Medium shot of two senior aristocrats in the carved choir stalls, resting on their canes and nodding in smug agreement.
EP41:E25 39800-43800 CAMERA: Close profile of Juliana as she halts in the center aisle, lifting her chin proudly to face the sneering onlookers.
EP41:E26 41000-44200 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Derisive, Projecting]: "Lady Juliana Ashcroft. Look around."
EP41:E27 43800-48500 CAMERA: High-angle wide shot showing Juliana flanked by guards in the center of the lavishly decorated nave, dwarfed by the grand cathedral.
EP41:E28 45000-48000 CATHERINE [V.O.) (Mocking, Resonant]: "This is the world you thought you belonged to."
EP41:E29 48500-52800 CAMERA: Low-angle medium shot of Catherine gesturing broadly from the altar steps, looking down upon Juliana like an empress.
EP41:E30 48600-52400 CATHERINE [Spiteful, Boastful]: "And now they can all see what you truly are."
EP41:E31 52800-57800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana standing firmly between the guards, calmly meeting Catherine's venomous gaze.
EP41:E32 54800-57500 ACTION: Juliana looks around the cathedral at the sea of pompous faces, then raises her eyes straight back to Catherine with utter disdain.
EP41:E33 57800-60800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Juliana's bruised, unshaken face.
EP41:E34 58000-60500 JULIANA [Defiant, Unbowed]: "You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?"
EP41:E35 60800-64000 CAMERA: Dramatic low-angle full shot looking up at Juliana, her posture straight, imposing, and regal despite the heavy chains.
EP41:E36 61000-63500 CATHERINE [O.S.) (Murmured, Cold]: "Still arrogant. Still standing."
EP41:E37 64000-68500 CAMERA: Full shot of Catherine turning back to Rupert at the altar, dismissing Juliana's defiance as beneath her.
EP41:E38 64500-65400 CATHERINE [Dismissive]: "Come."
EP41:E39 68500-70500 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's and Rupert's gloved hands clasping together over the velvet altar cushion.
EP41:E40 70500-75000 CAMERA: Medium two-shot of Catherine gazing up adoringly into Rupert's eyes, her tone intoxicatingly intimate.
EP41:E41 70500-74800 CATHERINE [Intimate, Ambitious]: "Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title."
EP41:E42 75000-77500 CAMERA: Close-up of Rupert's face breaking into a calculating, ambitious grin.
EP41:E43 75800-77000 BLOND NOBLEMAN [Quietly Triumphant]: "Nothing."
EP41:E44 77500-80500 CAMERA: Medium shot of the elderly Priest opening the leather-bound liturgical book between Rupert and Catherine.
EP41:E45 78000-79300 PRIEST [Solemn, Polite]: "Shall we?"
EP41:E46 80500-81800 CAMERA: Wide shot centered down the aisle toward the massive closed entrance doors.
EP41:E47 81000-85500 SOUND: Ear-splitting detonation, shattering stone, wood splintering violently into kindling, followed by terrified screams of the congregation.
EP41:E48 81800-84000 ACTION: A violent fireball bursts inward as the entire cathedral entrance explodes, blasting the massive double doors and masonry into flying shrapnel and billowing smoke.
EP41:E49 81800-84500 CAMERA: Rapid series of panic shots: aristocratic guests ducking behind pews, covering their heads in terror, women shrieking as plaster rains down.
EP41:E50 84500-88500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine and Rupert at the altar. Catherine gasps in horror, clutching her veil as debris rains over her bridal gown while Rupert spins around in shock.
EP41:E51 88500-92000 CAMERA: Medium wide shot of Juliana standing motionless in the middle of the aisle while thick smoke and dust billow from the demolished archway behind her.
EP41:E52 89000-93500 ACTION: Silhouetted armed figures emerge through the smoke and rubble of the breached doorway. Juliana slowly turns her head, glancing back toward the light.
EP41:E53 92000-96090 CAMERA: Extreme close-up pushing in on Juliana's bruised face. Her expression shifts from grim resolve into awe, breathless realization, and blooming hope as the orchestral score swells into an abrupt cliffhanger.
